title: Butter
author: Gene Hubert
notes: The Caller's Box 10320, permission: full. **FR-C2 halved this dance's own shift.** "Shift left" moves half a couple width - one dancer position, 20 px - since DD54, so `startPlaces` puts every dancer half a couple place back rather than a whole one and `slide-left`'s default `alongPx` is `PLACE_PITCH_PX`. Measured before -> after at every checked length (4-12): closure, reach and collision unchanged and green (0.0000, 0.0000, 8.500 px); `progressed` **0.0000 everywhere**, where at the odd lengths it silently read 68.0000 (M9f's finding). The motion rows the slide used to cost are gone with it: `wait-out` hand 120.3 -> 53.6, elbow 823.8 -> 60.7, elbow-per-hand 218.5x -> 1.76x and travel 43.0 -> 15.3 px/beat, so E27's `wait-out travel` allowlist row has nothing left to allow and is deleted; `swing` travel 38.1 -> 15.5 and `long-lines` 35.5 -> 3.9. The slide itself is 10.0 px/beat over its two beats.
